lines.text: Stars are shining, but I'm feeling alone,
Wishing you were here, calling on the phone.
Memories replay like a favorite song,
Need your warmth where I belong.
Distance hurts, but love remains,
Through the rains, break these chains.
Hold me close, don't let go,
In your arms, let feelings show.
Through the dark, be my guide,
Hold me close, side by side.
Laughter echoes from days gone by,
Tears fall soft, I can't deny.
Promise me we'll find our way,
Back together, come what may.
Heart's whispering your name so sweet,
In this beat, our souls meet.
Hold me close, don't let go,
In your arms, let feelings show.
Through the dark, be my guide,
Hold me close, side by side.
Time will heal, love will grow,
Just need you to know.
Hold me close, don't let go,
In your arms, let feelings show.
Through the dark, be my guide,
Hold me close, forever abide.
